note: Three hand-authored personas for the ICVP (WHO 'yellow card') validator. validateCertificate(data) runs VAL001-VAL011 in a fixed order (VAL012, language, is not enforced in the static form) and returns { overallValid, firedRules }; overallValid is true only when no fired rule has severity 'error' (VAL004/008/009/010/011 are 'warning', the rest are 'error'). VAL001 ('vaccination date in the future') reads the real wall clock, so the oracle's frozen clock (2026-09-03T12:00:00Z, pinned explicitly here via the top-level 'clock' key) makes every date in these personas evaluated against that fixed 'today'. VAL003/VAL004/VAL008/VAL009 are gated on entryDisease === 'yellow-fever' and never fire for any other disease (persona 2 uses cholera specifically to isolate VAL002 and VAL010 from the yellow-fever-only checks). VAL002 (validity start before vaccination date) and VAL003 (yellow-fever validity start must be exactly vaccination date + 10 days) are independent checks - a state can fail one, both, or neither. addDays operates in UTC calendar days. Regenerate 'expected' with: bin/test-personas international-certificate-of-vaccination-or-prophylaxis --update

personas.name: Correctly completed yellow fever certificate
personas.description: Yellow fever vaccination 2026-06-01, validity starts exactly 10 days later (2026-06-11, matching VAL003's formula) with entryValidityIsLifetime 'yes' (so VAL004's missing-end-date check does not fire), manufacturer/batch/clinician-status/centre-stamp all recorded, patient aged 36 at vaccination (within the 9-month-to-60-year yellow-fever window), no pregnancy/breastfeeding/immunosuppression declared. Expect firedRules [] and overallValid true.

personas.name: Cholera certificate with an inconsistent validity date and a pregnancy declaration
personas.description: Non-critical edge case built to isolate the disease-agnostic checks from the yellow-fever-only ones. entryDisease 'cholera' (not yellow-fever), so VAL003/VAL004/VAL008/VAL009 cannot fire regardless of the dates. entryValidityStartsOn (2026-06-25) is set BEFORE entryVaccinationDate (2026-07-01), firing VAL002 (error). declaredPregnancy 'yes' fires VAL010 (warning) independently of the disease. Manufacturer, batch, clinician status, and centre stamp are all present, so VAL005-VAL007 do not fire. Expect firedRules [VAL002 (error), VAL010 (warning)] in that order, overallValid false (VAL002 is an error).

firedRules.message: Validity start is before vaccination date.
Vaccinee declared pregnancy/breastfeeding; yellow-fever vaccination is contraindicated.

personas.name: Critical - future-dated yellow fever entry with six missing/inconsistent fields
personas.description: Critical/highest-severity persona: nine of the eleven enforced rules fire simultaneously. entryVaccinationDate 2026-09-10 is after the frozen 'today' of 2026-09-03 (VAL001, error). entryValidityStartsOn 2026-09-05 is both before the vaccination date (VAL002, error) AND does not equal vaccinationDate+10 days = 2026-09-20 (VAL003, error). entryValidityEndsOn is blank and entryValidityIsLifetime is not 'yes' (VAL004, warning). entryManufacturer and entryBatchNumber are blank (VAL005, error). entryClinicianProfessionalStatus (the per-entry field, distinct from the top-level clinicianProfessionalStatus which stays filled) is blank (VAL006, error). entryCentreStampApplied is 'no' (VAL007, error). The patient is 66 years old at vaccination (VAL009, warning - the mutually-exclusive 'too young' VAL008 cannot also fire at this age). declaredImmunosuppression is 'yes' (VAL011, warning); pregnancy/breastfeeding are left 'no' so VAL010 does not also fire on top of an implausible combination for a 66-year-old. Expect firedRules in code order VAL001, VAL002, VAL003, VAL004, VAL005, VAL006, VAL007, VAL009, VAL011 (9 rules: 6 errors, 3 warnings), overallValid false.

firedRules.message: Vaccination date is in the future.
Validity start is before vaccination date.
Yellow-fever validity start must be vaccination date + 10 days.
Yellow-fever validity end overridden to lifetime per 2016 IHR amendment.
Manufacturer and batch number are required.
Supervising clinician signature/professional status is required.
Vaccinee is older than 60 years; yellow-fever vaccination needs clinician review.
Vaccinee declared immunosuppression; yellow-fever vaccination is contraindicated.
